unmapped.label: IDEs
unmapped.raw_text: Proficiency with IDEs such as VSCode, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace preferred

parsed.seniority_signal: 2+ years of experience in software development
parsed.notes:
Specific Knowledge and Skills and Basic Requirements default to required; the two explicitly preferred items are optional. The closing encouragement to applicants does not make all skills optional.
Gemini and Windsurf are alternatives, but Windsurf has no taxonomy entry, so no two-member taxonomy alternative group can be emitted. Their broad AI coding assistants criterion is not an alternative member.
JavaScript/Node.js and SQL/BigQuery are read literally as paired technologies, not explicit alternatives.
Google Docs automation is mapped to workflow-automation; Google Docs itself is unmapped. All entries in the IDEs sentence are preferred, including the named productivity suites.
Database Management is retained as unmapped rather than inferred to mean data modeling or another database skill.
Seniority is inferred from the two-year experience threshold; Experienced alone is not a level signal.
Technical communication and translating business requirements are treated as soft skills, not taxonomy skills.
